summary: Iteration 12 P1 retest — DELETE /api/hairdressers/me/services/{sid} is now a HARD delete (row disappears, not soft-flip). Auth guards return 403 for customer callers, 404 for nonexistent ids. Business Success Score & Braider DNA cards are Pressable and navigate to /pro/growth. Backend: 189/189 tests pass (185 pre-existing + 4 new hard-delete regression tests). Iteration 12 studio suite: 15/15. Frontend: Amara login → create service (180/240min/first hairstyle chip) → row appears → Remove → row vanishes (0 delete buttons remaining, 0 INACTIVE badges — confirms HARD delete, not soft). Business Success Score tap → /pro/growth (pass). Braider DNA tap → /pro/growth (pass). Sign out → /welcome (pass). Tab bar operational.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2017-2026 — DELETE endpoint correctly ordered: role check (403) BEFORE existence check (404), and delete_one is scoped by both id and hairdresser_id so cross-tenant deletion is impossible.

Existing test_iteration12_studio.py::test_8_delete_service comment still says 'soft delete' but its assertion (sid not in public list) still holds under hard-delete — no test-code change needed, but comment is now stale (cosmetic).

studio.tsx:183-207 — Both insight cards use Pressable with testIDs studio-success-score / studio-braider-dna; chevron affordance now matches interaction. Consistent with adjacent studio-{section} pattern.
seed_data_creation: None. Test creates & tears down its own service rows via amara@braids.demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 P1 delete fix is production-ready. If future changes touch /api/hairdressers/me/services DELETE, re-run test_iteration12_delete_fix.py — it verifies hard-delete semantics, 404, 403, and 401/403 unauth. Note the stale 'soft delete' comment on line 186 of test_iteration12_studio.py::test_8_delete_service (still passes; cosmetic only).
rca_of_issue: Original issue: DELETE endpoint only flipped active:false, so removed rows still appeared in the hairdresser's own services list (as INACTIVE) and could still be re-toggled. Fix replaces update_one with delete_one and adds explicit 404 when delete_count==0 plus 403 for non-hairdressers. Verified via 4 new regression tests and end-to-end UI: after Remove, 0 rows remain and 0 INACTIVE badges are rendered.
release_readiness_notes: Deducted 2 for the stale 'soft delete' comment in test_iteration12_studio.py:186 (cosmetic; test still passes and correctly asserts absence). All 189 backend tests + 5/5 targeted frontend flows + tab bar + sign-out regression pass.
